title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-02 (PIN S4/A4, MW-3 stream-truncated hard-fail) — the dogfood 'stream error (unknown)' incident class: a stream cut WITHOUT message_stop must hard-fail as SamplingEvent::Failed { error_type: stream_truncated, message: 'stream ended without done (no message_stop)' } (xai-grok-sampler stream/messages.rs, spec G6), NOT a silent Completed with partial content (the pre-MW-3 behavior; A4 ratifies MW-3 hard-fail SURVIVES the merge). Lane: claude-sonnet-5 on /v1/messages behind wiretap (frozen lane L-03; 06 says 'any lane' — messages is where the MW-3 message_stop condition lives). INDUCTION: wiretap-injected truncated SSE (06 §1: the dogfood wire-tap launcher cuts the stream after content deltas, before message_stop/[DONE]) — the harness CANNOT inject it (wiretap2 is pass-through; no fault injection): this live case is therefore DISABLED until the wave-3 operator fault-injection arm lands (DRIVER GAP C-02, see smoke/merge-xai/README.md). The capture-SHAPE half of the cell is executable NOW as MXAI-C02-TRUNC-SHAPE (pre-placed truncated resp, kind=resp_stream mode=exact — pins the 'no frame past the last delta' condition on the capture). When injection exists, launch this case against the injected stream: the scored pins below are the verdict surface. VERDICT: PASS = honest error terminal with the stream_truncated phrasing recorded, wire capture carries no message_stop frame, no silent Completed. RED semantics: a clean end/error-free terminal after a KNOWN-injected truncation = the MW-3 pin regressed = the merge is NOT green on S4 (report-and-stop). On first enable, if the binary-of-record exits 0 on a stream error, that is itself the silent-fail signal: keep exit:1 (the honest-failure terminal) and flag the phrasing in the recon.

steps.prompt: Write a 1500-word essay about the history of lighthouses, covering at least three named lighthouses. Begin the essay immediately.

ndjson.label: MW-3 HARD-FAIL PIN: after the injected mid-stream cut, the turn must surface an honest error terminal — the 'stream error (stream_truncated) … without done' class (spec G6). Absent error event = the turn terminated quietly = the incident class is live = defect.

PHRASING RECORD (recon): the verbatim error message — must read 'stream error (stream_truncated)…' (the MW-3 G6 shape). A 'stream error (unknown)' phrasing = the dogfood incident class is live post-merge = STOP (house rule).

SILENT-COMPLETED CHECK (recon): the end event's stopReason, if any end event follows the error — an end_turn/clean stop after a known-injected truncation is the pre-MW-3 silent-Completed shape = defect (adjudicate on this record; the scored surface is trunc_error).

wire.label: WIRE-SIDE TRUNCATION CONDITION: the truncated stream capture carries NO message_stop frame (the MW-3 'without done' condition on the wire — the injection cut the stream before the terminal frame). Present = the stream was not actually truncated = the premise failed = STOP (the error pin would then be scoring the wrong induction).

NO RETRY STORM: 1-2 requests = the clean shape (the truncated turn + one tolerated side call); >3 = retry storm around the truncation = defect (COMP-3 shape). Note: the MW-3 hard-fail is a NON-retryable terminal (Failed, not a retryable status) — a storm here = the retry classifier regressed.
